clips.line: Listen, I just want to thank you for this great opportunity.
clips.note: Someone finally gets a job in show business. He says: Thank you for this great opportunity.
clips.noteUa: Хтось нарешті отримав роботу в шоу-бізнесі і каже: дякую за цю чудову можливість.
around: After all your years of struggling, you’ve finally been able to crack your way into show business.

clips.line: And this is the perfect opportunity.
clips.note: Someone has a secret. A friend says: You must tell people, and this is the perfect opportunity (the right moment).
clips.noteUa: У когось є таємниця. Подруга каже: ти мусиш розповісти, і зараз ідеальна можливість (слушний момент).
around: Look, you’re the only person who knows, so please don’t tell anyone.
Well, I won’t, but you have to, Ro.

clips.note: Sheldon talks about a mistake. He says it was a learning opportunity: he learned something from it.
clips.noteUa: Шелдон говорить про помилку: це була можливість чогось навчитися.
around: Dr. Sturgis was a wise man.
And when the day comes that I am wrong, I fully plan to admit it.
